summary: Validated Safari-mobile 'Erro ao salvar equipe' fix end-to-end. Backend: 20/20 pytest cases PASS sequentially (added 4 new tests: access_token in login body, access_token in register body, full team CRUD via Authorization Bearer only with cookies cleared, and 401 on invalid bearer). Frontend Playwright: login persists access_token to localStorage; team creation succeeds both WITH cookies AND after ALL cookies are cleared (simulating Safari iframe cookie block) — Bearer interceptor kicks in and every /api/* call now succeeds; logout clears localStorage. Bug is FIXED.

minor.issue: TestDashboardStats delta assertion is flaky under parallel workers because TestProjectsCRUD creates/deletes projects concurrently. Passes 100% sequentially. Consider marking dashboard test with @pytest.mark.serial or scoping by user_id snapshot instead of raw deltas.
safe_object_id already wraps invalid ObjectId -> 404. Confirmed.
Still no brute-force lockout / rate limiting (playbook recommends 5-fail lockout). Pre-existing minor.

issues: Still uses native <input type='date'> instead of shadcn calendar — cosmetic only, pre-existing.

action_items: None blocking. Main agent may optionally: (1) add rate-limit/lockout on /auth/login, (2) refactor TestDashboardStats to be xdist-safe, (3) migrate ProjectDrawer date fields to shadcn Calendar.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py get_current_user now correctly falls back to Authorization Bearer when cookie is absent (lines 57-64). Verified via new pytest test_full_team_crud_via_bearer_only_no_cookies.
server.py login/register include access_token in UserResponse body (lines 180-187, 204-211). This is the essential piece so Safari-iframe clients can persist the token in localStorage.

AuthContext.jsx axios.interceptors.request injects Bearer from localStorage on every request unless Authorization is already set (lines 13-19). Interceptor is defined at module scope so it applies globally to all axios usage.
AuthContext.jsx logout() properly removes localStorage.access_token in the finally block (line 101) so token is cleared even if the /auth/logout call fails.
checkAuth() clears the stale token on 401 (line 49). Good defensive behavior.

success_rate.backend: 100% (20/20 pytest sequential; 19/20 under xdist due to unrelated race in TestDashboardStats)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (7/7 flags: localStorage_has_token, team_create_with_cookies, cookies_cleared, token_survives, dashboard_bearer_only, team_create_bearer_only, logout_clears_localStorage)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug 'Erro ao salvar equipe' on Safari mobile is FIXED. Backend now returns access_token in login/register JSON body; frontend axios interceptor sends it as Authorization: Bearer for every request, working even when cookies are blocked. Regression suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py has TestAccessTokenInBody covering the fix. If retesting on a real iOS Safari, ensure ITP/3rd-party cookie block is active and confirm no 401 loop on /api/auth/me after login.
rca of the issue: Root cause: Safari mobile inside app.emergent.sh iframe blocks cross-site cookies (even with SameSite=none; Secure), so the httpOnly access_token cookie set by /auth/login was never sent back on subsequent XHR calls, causing every /api/teams, /api/projects and /api/dashboard/stats to return 401 and the frontend to surface 'Erro ao salvar equipe'. Mitigation implemented and verified: (a) backend UserResponse now includes access_token, and login/register return it in JSON body; (b) frontend saves it to localStorage and an axios request interceptor injects Authorization: Bearer <token> on every request as fallback when cookies are blocked; (c) backend get_current_user already accepts either cookie or Authorization Bearer header. Verified end-to-end via Playwright by clearing all browser cookies and confirming team creation still succeeds via Bearer only.
